description: Home hero says the agent 'shows a pairing code, and you approve it', console Agents panel says 'open it and click Approve', quickstart.md says 'check that the code matches ... and click Approve'; /llms.txt and /connect require a second, never-shown 16-hex verification code.
expected: All surfaces mention the verification code the human must type.
actual: Website copy mentions one code; the approve page demands another.
evidence: home hero: 'Free to start. Your agent shows a pairing code, and you approve it in your account.'; console Agents panel; GET /docs/quickstart.md step 3
suggested_fix: Add 'type the verification code your agent prints' to hero hint, console panel and quickstart.

description: On a 390px viewport the Verification code input is ~165px wide; placeholder and typed value are cut off after three groups.
expected: Field wide enough to show 'a1b2 c3d4 e5f6 7890' or label stacks above input.
actual: Placeholder reads 'a1b2 c3d4 e5f6' and the last group is hidden.
suggested_fix: Stack label above the input on narrow screens.

description: `agent-drive skill install` with no ~/.claude or ~/.codex prints instructions but exits 0 although nothing was written.
actual: Exit 0: 'No ~/.claude or ~/.codex directory found. The skill is at ...; copy it to <skills dir>/agent-drive/SKILL.md, or use --target <dir>.'
suggested_fix: Exit non-zero, so an agent following llms.txt step 5 does not report the skill installed.

description: Login prints 'Ignored a different API URL returned by the server.' with no explanation of what was ignored or why (likely an artifact of the local origin).
expected: Either silent or says which URL and that the --api value is kept.
actual: Unexplained warning before 'Logged in as agent ...'.
evidence: CLI out.log line before 'Logged in as agent billing-api agent.'
suggested_fix: Name both URLs or drop the line when harmless.

description: Pointing AGENT_DRIVE_API_URL at the site origin (no /api) fails with a bare status and no URL or hint.
expected: Message naming the URL tried and suggesting the /api suffix.
suggested_fix: Include the URL and hint that the API URL ends in /api.

description: Right after a successful agent connection the console Files page says 'Ready for your first file. Connect an agent with the CLI or MCP to upload encrypted files.' and shows 'Key needed · Not backed up', as if no agent were connected.
expected: Acknowledge that an agent is connected and wait for its first file; explain the 'Key needed' chip.
suggested_fix: If the drive has an agent but no files, say 'billing-api agent is connected; its first file will appear here.'
